newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip for the third day in a row.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip for the third day in a row.

text.p: Slovenian shares lost 1.03 percent on Wednesday, easing for the third session in a row, but traders said the market was likely to bottom out soon.

"Prices are already so low that they are not likely to fall much further, it is not impossible that even domestic investors could start buying now on such low prices," said Jasna Zontar, a trader at brokerage Modra.
* The SBI index fell 13.75 points to 1,321.19.
* Overall six shares fell, six rose and three were flat, while 12 were untraded.
* Brokerage Dadas led the day's decliners, tumbling 7.3 percent to 7,500 tolars on volume of 10 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-81-125-8439
